quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice thereof, a person shall not stand or park a vehicle upon the left-hand side of a one-way street.

activation.condition: Official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice on a source-reviewed one-way street.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Street direction, official notice erection and extent, the statutory left side, and stopping purpose require reviewed originals. No legal side or time cutoff is inferred.
